translations.web: Do not abhor us, for your name’s sake. Do not disgrace the throne of your glory. Remember, and don’t break your covenant with us.
translations.bsb: For the sake of Your name do not despise us; do not disgrace Your glorious throne. Remember Your covenant with us; do not break it.
translations.kjv: Do not abhor us, for thy name's sake, do not disgrace the throne of thy glory: remember, break not thy covenant
translations.asv: Do not abhor us, for thy name's sake; do not disgrace the throne of thy glory: remember, break not thy covenant with us.
